description: This file defines API functions for interacting with 'calls' and 'categories' data in a sales call audit platform. It includes functions for fetching dashboards, listing calls with filters, getting call details by ID, and listing categories, with support for mock data when API is unavailable.

methods.name: hasApi()
methods.description: Checks if the API client has a valid base URL, indicating whether real API calls can be made.

methods.name: sleep(ms)
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: maybeMockDelay()
methods.description: Simulates network latency in mock mode to make UI interactions feel more realistic.

methods.name: normalizeRisk(risk)
methods.description: Normalizes risk levels to 'low', 'medium', or 'high' for consistent filtering.

methods.name: getDashboardSummary()
methods.description: Fetches dashboard KPIs and summary data, either from the API or mock data.

methods.name: listCalls(filters = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of calls filtered by optional criteria such as query, category, and risk, from API or mock data.

methods.name: getCallById(callId)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific call identified by its ID, from API or mock data.

methods.name: listCategories()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of call categories used for filtering, from API or mock data.
